headlines.title: Diamondback Energy, Inc. Announces Core Midland Basin Acquisition
headlines.summary: MIDLAND, Texas, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Diamondback Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FANG) (“Diamondback” or “the Company”) today announced that it has entered into a definitive purchase agreement to acquire certain subsidiaries of Double Eagle IV Midco, LLC and Double Eagle V Midco, LLC (together “Double Eagle”) in exchange for approximately 15.56 million shares of Diamondback common stock and $2.15 billion of cash, subject to customary adjustments (the “Double Eagle Acquisition”).

headlines.title: Diamondback Energy nears $5 bln Double Eagle deal - report
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Diamondback Energy is close to finalizing a deal worth approximately $5 billion to purchase a drilling portfolio from Double Eagle, a Texas-based energy producer, according to a Financial Times report citing sources familiar with the matter.

headlines.title: How Investors May Respond To Diamondback Energy (FANG) Earnings Beat
headlines.summary: Diamondback Energy reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$5.431b and net income of US$1.603b, updated production guidance for 2026, and increased its base dividend to US$1.18 per share. The combination of higher reported earnings, raised oil production targets and a larger base dividend signals management confidence in Diamondback Energy's operating and capital return framework.

headlines.summary: Diamondback (FANG) witnesses a hammer chart pattern, indicating support found by the stock after losing some value lately. This coupled with an upward trend in earnings estimate revisions could mean a trend reversal for the stock in the near term.

description: Diamondback Energy, Inc., an independent oil and natural gas company, acquires, develops, explores, and exploits unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin in West Texas, the United States. The company primarily focuses on the development of the Spraberry and Wolfcamp formations of the Midland Basin; and the Wolfcamp and Bone Spring formations of the Delaware Basin, both of which are part of the Permian Basin in West Texas and New Mexico. Diamondback Energy, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, Texas.
